# HardConnectivityConstraints

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Fixed, non-negotiable limits on the number, type, or placement of physical links between processing nodes in a network. Reflects real-world physical wiring limitations in in-network computing, requiring topology design that respects manufacturing or deployment constraints.
